motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 0.01ms; no Lenis; no embers or flicker; Method becomes a native snap row; creature mixer frozen
motion.purpose: Every scene keeps a readable static form.

scene.forge: kiln-made forge.glb (the logo in 3D) on a sticky canvas; ACES filmic tone mapping; fog on night; fire point light, cool rim, warm fill; ~420 additive embers recycled from the mouth; UnrealBloomPass (0.55, 0.5, 0.82) on emissive things; camera view offset of 22% of width (landscape) or 20% of height (portrait) so the type never covers the forge; still image fallback without WebGL.
scene.creatures: Animated kiln GLBs in a live viewport, each a SkeletonUtils clone so the skin follows its own skeleton; drag to orbit, auto-spin after 1.5s idle.
scene.grain: Fixed SVG fractal-noise overlay, opacity 0.07, mix-blend overlay, z-index 30.

narrative.overview:
The page is night, and the only light in it comes from the fire. A kiln-made forge (the logo, built in 3D by kiln itself) burns in a full-bleed WebGL scene; the scroll is the camera, falling into the forge, watching objects rise out of it and get graded against the real thing. The document is not a page with a 3D frame in it: the scene is the page, and the type stands beside the fire, never over it.

Everything else is lit by that fire or sits in shadow. Ember and molten are light sources, not decoration: they glow (bloom on emissive meshes, ember halos on the primary action and the "after" bars, a text glow on the ratio), and the ground stays a warm near-black. Film grain lies fixed over the whole viewport. Clash Display is set huge and tight; Geist carries the reading; Geist Mono carries every measured number. Controls are pills, and evidence sits on double-bezel plates like objects on a stand.

Motion is scroll-scrubbed and pinned (GSAP ScrollTrigger on Lenis smooth scroll), and every pinned scene has a reduced-motion form that is a plain, readable layout rather than a frozen frame.
keyCharacteristics: Night ground (#0b0908) lit only by ember, molten and kiln's flame; slate is the forge's stone.
One continuous WebGL forge driving the first act; the camera view is offset so the headline never covers the fire.
Clash Display at cinematic sizes, Geist for text, Geist Mono for every number.
Pill controls and a floating pill nav; double-bezel plates (6px shell around a core).
Translucent bone and ember alphas as named tints, never opaque greys.
The page ends inside the fire: a radial fire gradient carries the closing install.

rules.name: The Only Light Rule
rules.body: Light comes from the fire. Bright surfaces are molten, ember or the fire gradient; there is no neutral light-grey panel anywhere on the page.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: A render with a grey studio ground is an object on a stand: it sits in a plate core, never on the page ground.

rules.name: The Two Marks Rule
rules.body: Red and cyan are the bench's marking. They appear only in the bench overlay, never as accent, state or error color on the site.

rules.name: The Measured Number Rule
rules.body: Every number on the page is set in Geist Mono with tabular figures and comes from `src/content/site.json`; nothing is typed into a component.

rules.name: The Glow Is Heat Rule
rules.body: A glow is ember-colored and sits under something the fire lit. A grey drop shadow under a card is not part of this world.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: Film grain (SVG fractal noise, opacity 0.07, overlay blend) is fixed over the whole viewport and never scrolls or repaints.

dos: Do keep the page ground night (#0b0908) and let only molten, ember and the fire gradient be bright.
Do set controls as pills (999px) and evidence as double-bezel plates (6px shell, core radius = shell minus 6px).
Do use the named bone and ember alpha tints for borders, washes and glows instead of opaque greys.
Do set every number in Geist Mono with tabular figures, sourced from `src/content/site.json`.
Do keep the forge visible beside the type: offset the camera view, never stack type over the fire.
Do give every pinned or scrubbed scene a reduced-motion layout (Method becomes a snap row; embers and flicker stop; Lenis is not started).
Do have kiln make every 3D asset on the page (the forge, specimens, creatures).
donts: Don't put a grey studio render on the page ground; it goes in a plate core.
Don't use red or cyan anywhere but the bench overlay marking.
Don't use em-dashes in visible copy.
Don't type a figure into a component, or show testimonials, user logos or "trusted by" claims.
Don't use grey drop shadows or hard offset shadows; depth is ember glow, inset rings and the scene's own light.
Don't pin a scene without a reduced-motion fallback.
